mapper.sql: FROM bill b JOIN fee_item f ON f.id = b.item_id LEFT JOIN house h ON h.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND h.house_id = b.house_id LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND o.owner_id = b.owner_id
mapper.select:
SELECT b.bill_no AS bill_id, b.community_id AS community_id, h.building_id AS building_id, h.unit_id AS unit_id, b.house_id AS house_id, h.full_name AS house_name, b.owner_id AS owner_id, o.name AS owner_name, btrim(b.period) AS period, b.status AS status, f.item_code AS item_id, b.item_name AS item_name, b.unit AS unit, b.quantity AS quantity, b.price AS price, b.amount AS amount, b.waive_amount AS discount, b.late_fee AS late_fee, b.payable AS payable, b.paid_amount AS paid_amount, (b.payable - b.waive_amount - b.paid_amount) AS unpaid, CASE WHEN b.payable - b.waive_amount - b.paid_amount > 0 AND b.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN CURRENT_DATE - b.due_date END AS overdue_days, b.due_date AS due_date, (SELECT max(p.paid_at) FROM payment_allocation a JOIN payment p ON p.id = a.payment_id AND p.status = '正常' WHERE a.bill_id = b.id) AS pay_time, b.created_at AS create_time, CASE WHEN b.parking_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'park' ELSE 'house' END AS subject_type, b.version AS version
ORDER BY b.period DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
